H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H347: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience
H4405: a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H238: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
H6605: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H3956: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H2441: properly, the palate or inside of the mouth; hence, the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)

H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H5397: a puff, i.e. wind, angry or vital breath, divine inspiration, intellect. or (concretely) an animal
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H3201: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H6186: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H3320: to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue
H2563: properly, a bubbling up, i.e. of water, a wave; of earth, mire or clay (cement); also a heap; hence, a chomer or dry measure

H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H405: a load; by implication, a stroke (others dignity)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications

H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)

H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present

H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)

H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H734: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
H6663: to be (causatively, make) right (in a moral or forensic sense)

H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H582: a man in general (singly or collectively)

H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H7789: to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H4904: a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse
H227: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
H1540: to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal
H2856: to close up; especially to seal
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H1397: properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply
H3680: properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy)
H2820: to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; to observe
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H7845: a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H7973: a missile of attack, i.e. spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth; i.e. branch
H3198: to be right (i.e. correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict
H6106: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
H386: permanence; hence (concrete) permanent; specifically a chieftain
H2092: to be rancid, i.e. (transitively) to loathe
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H3978: an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit)
H8378: a longing; by implication, a delight (subjectively, satisfaction, objectively, a charm)
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H7210: sight, whether abstractly (vision) or concretely (a spectacle)
H8205: bareness; concretely, a bare hill or plain
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H7126: to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose
H4191: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
H3426: there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection)
H4397: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)
H3887: properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede
H505: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)

H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H5934: (only in plural as abstract) adolescence; figuratively, vigor
H6279: to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer)
H7521: to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy adebt
H8643: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum
H6666: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
H2398: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn
H7737: properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.)
H6299: to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H6466: to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise
H6471: a stroke, literally or figuratively (in various applications, as follow)
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H215: to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically)
H7181: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
H2790: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
H2654: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H502: hence, to learn (and causatively to teach)
